feat(spark): parse all ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN[S] forms [CLAUDE] (#8611)

* feat(spark): parse all ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN[S] forms [CLAUDE]

Spark2Parser's _parse_drop_column returned None for everything but
DROP COLUMNS, so DROP COLUMN, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS and unparenthesized
DROP COLUMNS lists fell back to exp.Command. It now handles only the plural
form and defers the rest to the base parser, so those forms build an AST.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(spark): accept keyword column names in DROP COLUMNS and assert Alter AST in tests [CLAUDE]

DROP COLUMNS (from) parsed on main but raised after switching to _parse_column;
parse names with _parse_field_def again, which accepts any token. The tests now
also check that an exp.Alter wrapping an exp.Drop is built, since an exp.Command
would round-trip the input text as well.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
